name: Tenshou Enka Enblaze
original_name: 天翔炎華エンブレイズ
source:
When a girl makes her dream come true, the world drowns in Despair.

"Magical girls are destined to fight Ralfa - monsters eating away at our world"

Nijino Yumeha, soon to start attending Private Tensei Girls' Academy, witnessed two magical girls locked in battle while touring the campus the evening before her transfer. When one of them, Tsukimori Kyou, shared this truth, Yumeha vowed to fight by her side. She had no idea this choice would lead to her own destruction.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.chaos-r.com/chr034/index.php]official site[/url]]
